title: Newark Airport shuttle bus crash sends 13 to hospital, driver cited for carelessness
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Thirteen people were injured after a shuttle bus smashed into a concrete barrier at Newark Liberty International Airport early Monday, police said.

The bus crashed on the Terminal B Departures Level 3 roadway around 3 a.m., according to the Port Authority Police Department.

Emergency services responded to the incident and 13 people were taken to a local hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, police said.

The bus driver was issued a citation for careless driving, sources told The Post.

Officials shut down the roadway as crews worked to clear the debris.

Photos from the scene show the front of the bus damaged and the windshield smashed, according to NBC New York.
